policy.note: Versions are frozen by the implementation plan. A null archive_sha256 blocks acquisition, packaging, and release.

packages.name: pjproject
packages.host_closure: exact-commit low-level signaling compile/link, UDP private-lab call, authenticated TLS hostname acceptance/rejection, and SHA-256 digest TLS proxy REGISTER/contact-specific unregister verified; the combined exact-source dependency suite passes 13/13 CTests
packages.arm_closure: exact pinned signaling-only static libraries built for ARM EABI5 with the digest-gated media/C++ exclusion patch, linked into ls200-sipd, passed the recovered-reference ABI gate, and executed in both recovered QEMU firmware slots; live SIP/TLS interoperability remains unproven

packages.name: nginx
packages.arm_closure: exact 1.31.4 source built for ARM EABI5 with the digest-gated LS200 cross patch and minimal HTTP/static/SSL/FastCGI module set, passed the recovered-reference ABI gate, and reported nginx/1.31.4 with OpenSSL 3.5.8 in both recovered QEMU firmware slots

packages.name: OpenSSL
packages.host_closure: compatible host OpenSSL used by gateway tests; exact 3.5.8 not acquired
packages.arm_closure: exact 3.5.8 source built no-asm as static ARM EABI5 libraries, linked into sipd, gateway, and nginx candidates whose dynamic closure and GLIBC ceiling passed; guest nginx reported OpenSSL 3.5.8, while live TLS and the unused async-context path remain unproven

packages.name: FastCGI
packages.arm_closure: exact 2.4.7 source built statically for ARM EABI5 and linked into the gateway candidate; the candidate passed the recovered-reference ABI gate and executed to its expected no-request exit in both recovered QEMU firmware slots

packages.name: Jansson
packages.host_closure: compatible system library used by gateway tests; exact source not acquired
packages.arm_closure: exact 2.14 source built statically for ARM EABI5 and linked into the gateway candidate; the candidate passed the recovered-reference ABI gate and executed in both recovered QEMU firmware slots

packages.name: FAAD2
packages.host_closure: exact locked source archive built statically without CLI or DRC and linked into the native AAC host gate; successful persistent AAC-LC priming/decode oracle passes
packages.arm_closure: exact 2.11.2 source built statically for ARM EABI5 and linked into ls200-sipd; the daemon passed the recovered-reference ABI gate and executed in both recovered QEMU firmware slots, but target AAC decode and live media remain unproven

packages.name: SpeexDSP
packages.host_closure: exact locked source archive built statically without examples or SSE and linked into the native AAC host gate; 8 kHz mono resampling oracle passes
packages.arm_closure: exact 1.2.1 source built statically for ARM EABI5 and linked into ls200-sipd; the daemon passed the recovered-reference ABI gate and executed in both recovered QEMU firmware slots, but target resampling, AEC, and live media remain unproven

packages.name: libsrtp
packages.host_closure: exact locked source archive built statically with the built-in crypto backend; upstream make runtest passes; strict AES_CM_128_HMAC_SHA1_80 RTP/SRTCP protect, unprotect, pre-unprotect tuple authorization, replay, tamper, wrong-key, full and mixed re-INVITE downgrade, and staged-timeout cleanup host oracles pass in the combined 13/13 CTest and ASan/UBSan suites
packages.arm_closure: exact 2.8.0 source built statically for ARM EABI5 and linked into ls200-sipd; the daemon passed the recovered-reference ABI gate and executed in both recovered QEMU firmware slots, but target SRTP traffic and Zoom negotiation remain unproven
